title: Higgins Digital
summary: The public platform for a Charlotte software development company.
tagline: Higgins Digital is the software development company I founded to build custom websites, web platforms, and AI-enabled systems for businesses. This case study covers the company's own platform and delivery approach.
role: Founder and web developer: brand, company website, service and project presentation, and end-to-end client delivery.
problem: I was already building websites and digital tools, but the work needed a company presence as professional as the output: one that communicates trust quickly, explains services clearly, and shows real work rather than promises.
contribution: I founded Higgins Digital in January 2026 and built its brand, website, service structure, and project presentation. For client work I manage the full lifecycle: requirements, UI and UX design, development, backend logic, deployment, DNS and SSL, and custom domains.
solution: I built Higgins Digital like a product rather than a landing page: a black-and-white brand system anchored by the blue H mark, six focused services (custom websites, website transformations, e-commerce and product sites, digital products and platforms, AI, automation, and data systems, and optimization and ongoing care), each with its own detail page, and a Work section of 14 delivered projects.
The same delivery approach runs through client projects such as the Higgins Building Group rebuild and Lakeside Sport Club.
solutionPoints: Brand identity, messaging, and a reusable design system.
Service, pricing, and process pages with a clear inquiry path.
Project case studies that lead with concrete work.
A repeatable delivery process from discovery through deployment and handoff.

architecture.summary: Brand, content, and frontend are designed together so the company site demonstrates the standard it sells.

decisions.title: Use concrete work as evidence.
decisions.text: Project pages lead with delivered work and before-and-after improvements instead of broad claims.

decisions.title: Keep the copy direct.
decisions.text: The messaging focuses on what business owners care about: credibility, speed, usability, ownership, and a clear next step.

decisions.title: Treat the company site as a platform.
decisions.text: The site is structured to grow with new case studies and services without a redesign.

tradeoffs.title: Visual polish vs. performance
tradeoffs.text: Motion and rich visuals have to stay light enough to support a performance-first promise.

tradeoffs.title: Founder brand vs. company brand
tradeoffs.text: The site benefits from my personal credibility while presenting Higgins Digital as a standalone business.

outcomes: Higgins Digital has a live company platform at higginsd.com and a public body of delivered client and product work, several of which appear in this gallery.
limits: Current services and pricing are published on higginsd.com rather than repeated here.
lessons: Showing concrete work and explaining the delivery process builds a clearer service proposition than broad promises.
sources: Existing portfolio Higgins Digital deep dive
